response.rationale: Intercellular IgG/C3 deposition and acantholysis are pathognomonic for pemphigus; photodistributed plaques and ANA positivity are nonspecific, and negative anti-Ro/La and anti-Smith argue against lupus.

rejected.why: No muscle weakness, elevated muscle enzymes, or classic dermatomyositis skin findings; DIF is not consistent.
DIF shows intercellular rather than predominantly basement membrane deposition; negative anti-Ro/La, anti-Smith, and normal complement make lupus less likely.
Negative anti-Ro/La and intercellular DIF pattern are atypical for SCLE, which usually shows granular BMZ deposition.
